newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products all easier and all quiet.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products all easier and all quiet.

text.p: NWE oil products were easier on Monday, traders said.
Naphtha fell slightly with crude but high freight rates and quiet end-user demand dried up physical trading.
Gasoline fell $1 to $217 fob ARA for Eurograde as traders looked for the US arbitrage to open before prices can rally.

Heating oil buying was slow and premiums a touch easier by 50 cents or so. Two refinery grade barges were sold at +$3.50 Feb IPE. High and low sulphur fuel eased amid slack demand and good supply of Russian. High sulphur barges were offered at $98 fob ARA.
